### 🧭 Epic

Title: Allow operators to configure a stable resource identifier for RFC 9728 metadata
so MCP clients can complete the Auth0 OAuth flow without registering every UUID-based
CF server URL as a separate Auth0 API.

Goal: When a virtual server's resource identifier (the resource field in the RFC 9728
Protected Resource Metadata response) is a UUID-based URL (/servers/{uuid}/mcp), MCP
clients include that URL as the resource parameter in authorization requests to Auth0
(per RFC 8707). Auth0 rejects it with access_denied: Service not found because only
